notes: design class, recent material. Assertions encode design judgment rather than API names — a good answer refuses the premise of the first task whether or not it has read this skill.

tasks.prompt: I'm updating my iOS app for the new design. My plan: apply the Liquid Glass material to the whole screen background AND to every card on it, so the app looks modern throughout. Review that plan.

expect.label: pushes back on glass over glass / glass everywhere
expect.pattern: glass on glass|glass over glass|stack(ing)? (translucent|glass)|not.{0,30}every|sparing|accent, not|avoid.{0,40}blanket

expect.label: reserves glass for the floating navigation/control layer
raises legibility or contrast as the cost

avoid.label: endorses blanketing the screen in glass

tasks.prompt: For a small transient overlay that shows fine print, which system material should I pick, and how should I tint a destructive action inside it?

expect.label: picks the material by role and required contrast, not by its apparent colour
connects material thickness to legibility of fine text
tints sparingly and through the system path
mentions accessibility settings changing the rendering
